source: This framing becomes especially important in AI kernels whose data volumes are enormous. A modest improvement in reuse can remove gigabytes of ZXNAME0000XZ traffic, while a spectacular hit-rate percentage on a tiny side structure may have almost no effect on wall-clock time.
zh: 这种框架在数据量巨大的人工智能内核中变得尤为重要。重用方面的适度改进可以消除千兆字节的 ZXNAME0000XZ 流量，而微小侧面结构上惊人的命中率百分比可能对挂钟时间几乎没有影响。
